senses.gloss:
उलुप उलुप, अस्, अम्, m. n. a spreading
creeper; (अस्), m. the reed Saccharum Cylindricum.
See उलप.

उलुपिन् उलुपिन् or उलपिन् or उलूपिन्, ई, m.
a guinea-pig, a porpoise or fish resembling it.

ऊलुपिन् ऊलुपिन्, ई, m. a porpoise. See
उलुपिन्.

उलुलि उलुलि, इस्, इस्, इ or इस्, m., Ved. ulula-
tion, howling, a howl; [cf. Lat. ululabilis, ululatus.]

उलूक उलूक, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. वल्),
an owl; N. of a country and people (pl.), and of their
king, who appears in the Mahā-bhārata as a hero on
the side of the Kurus; a son of Viśvā-mitra; of Śakuni;
an epithet of Indra; N. of a king of the Nāgas; (अम्),
n., N. of the reed Saccharum Cylindricum; [cf. Lat.
ulula; Germ. Eule; Old Germ. uwila, ûla; Eng.
owl; Fr. hulotte.]
—उलूक-यातु, उस्, m., Ved. a
demon in the shape of an owl.
—उलूकाश्रम (˚क-
आश्˚), अस्, m. Indra's hermitage.
ऊलूक ऊलूक, अस्, m. an owl. See उलूक.

उलूखल उलूखल, अम्, n. a wooden mortar
used for cleansing rice from the husk &c.; bdellium,
a gummy substance; (अस्), m. a staff of Udumbara
wood, carried on certain occasions; N. of an evil
spirit.
—उलूखल-सुत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. pressed out
or pounded in a mortar.

उलूखलक, अम्, n., Ved. a mortar; bdellium, a
gummy substance, or the plant which produces it.

उलूखलिक, अस्, आ, अम्, pounded in a mortar,
cleansed from the husk; (at the end of a compound)
using as a mortar (e. g. दन्तोलूखलिक, using the
teeth as a mortar).

उलूट उलूट or उतूल or कुलूट, आस्, m. pl.,
N. of a people.
उलूत उलूत, अस्, m. a large snake, the Boa.

उलूलु उलूलु, उस्, उस्, उ or उस्, m. ululation,
howling. See उलुलि.

उल्लुञ्चन उल्-लुञ्चन, अम्, n. plucking out
the hair; cutting the hair; pulling.

उल्लुण्ठा उल्-लुण्ठा, f. (fr. rt. लुण्ठ् with उद्),
irony.

उल्लू उल्-लू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ (fr. rt. लू with उद्),
cutting up.
